normalization.canonical_radial_convention: Lkin=Z/2 (dr)^2, V=c2 r^2+c4 r^4; phi=sqrt(Z)r; lambda_canonical=4 c4/Z^2
normalization.boundary: This fixes the algebra and the field-redefinition law, not the missing dynamical source-to-canonical kinetic coefficient Z or the complete action.

neutral.neutral_metric: Before quotienting gauge phases: G_(a,b,d,alpha)=diag(2,2,2,2b^2). Full scalar masses use all 68 coordinates and the gauge-orbit projection.
